ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the image there is a green plant, with leaves, a stem, and an underground root system; there is the sun in the upper right; around the plant there are several blank label boxes with letters and arrows, one of the arrows points to the leaves, another arrow is near the sun, and there are also arrows underground. Reasoning: The question asks “What gas do plants take in?”, that is, what gas plants absorb. According to knowledge of photosynthesis, plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air through their leaves, and use water and sunlight to make nutrients, while releasing oxygen. Therefore, the gas that plants absorb is carbon dioxide.
